title: TLUE: A Tibetan Language Understanding Evaluation Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing zero-shot accuracy of large language models on high-resource language benchmarks (e.g., CMMLU, SafetyBench) versus a translated and culturally adapted low-resource Tibetan benchmark (TLUE) to quantify performance disparities and measure underrepresentation.
Evaluating model responses on a specific 'Unfairness and Bias' subset of the multiple-choice Ti-SafetyBench dataset to assess safety alignment and fairness in Tibetan.

Assessing models using multiple-choice questions that have been manually aligned by native experts to reflect Tibetan cultural norms and local knowledge systems, measuring the models' ability to handle culturally specific contexts.
